description: Unified neutral override gate. Contains per-engine neutral rules. Intended to be applied after the core engine produces a Bull/Bear/Neutral prediction.

logic: If pred_label in {Bull,Bear} and abs(z) <= min_trade_z then Neutral (weak-z neutral band).
Optional: if near0_force_neutral==true and near0==true then Neutral.
notes: EMA_RB_v3c already contains internal neutral logic (DISAGREE corner + near0 handling). This external gate is an extra safety band you can widen/tighten without editing EMA_RB_v3c.json.

logic: If pred_label in {Bull,Bear} and abs(ema_slope) <= min_trade_ema_slope_abs and abs(vwap_drift) <= min_trade_vwap_abs then Neutral.
notes: Defaults are 0 (disabled). Enable only if you want an external neutral band on B1 during offline testing.
